issue.title: Deprecate Plugin::routes()

repository.name: cakephp
repository.description: CakePHP: The Rapid Development Framework for PHP - Official Repository

issue.body:
I missed this earlier as I had updated my applications and removed this line. With this method undeprecated plugins will have their routes loaded twice. Once by `Application::pluginRoutes()` and again by `Plugin::routes()`. Because we're trending away from static APIs, and the `BasePlugin::route()` gives more control/flexibility I'm deprecating this method.

Refs #12130

It works if in the `Application::bootstrap()` method I load the plugin like that:

```
$this->addPlugin(RecaptchaMailhide::class, ['routes' => false]);
```

This prevents the route from being loaded twice.

If you are using `$routes->loadPlugin()` you currently also need to disable the routes hook for your plugin. I can look into making those two ways of loading plugin routes work better together. I think it should be solvable if plugins track whether or not their routes have been included yet.
